dialogue.content: こんにちは、相談者役です。今日はよろしくお願いいたします。
dialogue.English: Hello, I'll be playing the client. Thank you for working with me today.

dialogue.content: こちらこそよろしくお願いいたします。
dialogue.English: Thank you; I look forward to working with you as well.

dialogue.content: 始めさせていただいても大丈夫でしょうか？
dialogue.English: Shall we begin?

dialogue.content: はい、大丈夫です。お願いいたします。
dialogue.English: Yes, that's fine. Please go ahead.

dialogue.content: こんにちは。相談員です。はじめに、あなたの年齢と性別をお聞かせいただけますか？
dialogue.English: Hello. I'm your counselor. To begin, could you please tell me your age and gender?

dialogue.content: 30代女性です
dialogue.English: I'm a woman in my 30s.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます。本日はどのようなご相談ですか？
dialogue.English: Thank you. What would you like to talk about today?

dialogue.content: なにもやる気が起きません]
dialogue.English: I don't have the motivation to do anything.

dialogue.content: 気力がわかない状態なのですね。それはお辛いですね。
dialogue.English: So you're feeling a lack of energy. That must be very difficult for you.

dialogue.content: いつ頃からそのような気分になっているのでしょうか？
dialogue.English: About when did you start feeling this way?

dialogue.content: 今年の3月頃からです
dialogue.English: Since around March of this year.

dialogue.content: もう５か月になりますね。それはしんどいですね。
dialogue.English: So it's been five months now. That must be exhausting.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 普段の生活はどのようにお過ごしですか？
dialogue.English: What is your daily life like?

dialogue.content: お仕事や、家庭のこと、などなど。
dialogue.English: Things like your work, matters at home, and so on.

dialogue.content: 仕事に、家事、子育て、もう疲れてしまいました
dialogue.English: Work, housework, raising children... I'm just so tired of it all.

dialogue.content: お勤めに加えて、家のこと、お子さんのこともずっと抱えてこられたのですね。それは本当に我慢してこられましたね。
dialogue.English: So on top of your job, you've been handling everything at home and with your child. You've truly been enduring so much.

dialogue.content: ３月頃とのお話でしたが、その頃になにかきっかけになるようなエピソードはいかがですか？？
dialogue.English: You mentioned it started around March. Was there anything that happened around that time that might have been a trigger?

dialogue.content: 何もかも忙しすぎて、疲れてなにもやる気になれません
dialogue.English: Everything is just too busy, and I'm so tired that I can't bring myself to do anything.

dialogue.content: 本当に疲れてしまうと、頭も体もうまく動かなくなりますよね。
dialogue.English: When you're truly exhausted, your mind and body just don't function properly, do they?

dialogue.content: 仕事でも上司に呼びつけられて、説教されます
dialogue.English: At work, my boss calls me in and lectures me.

dialogue.content: 自分が悪いんですが…
dialogue.English: It's my fault, though...

dialogue.content: 残業もできず、仕事も遅れています
dialogue.English: I can't work overtime, and I'm falling behind on my work.

dialogue.content: ここまでお疲れなのに、それはさらにきついですね。
dialogue.English: On top of being so tired, that must make things even harder.

dialogue.content: 夫の両親とも同居なんですが、
dialogue.English: I also live with my husband's parents, and...

dialogue.content: はい。
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: 義母は精神病を患っていて、子育ても頼ることはありません
dialogue.English: My mother-in-law has a mental illness, so I can't rely on her for childcare.

dialogue.content: 私のことをいつもけなしてくるんで
dialogue.English: She's always putting me down.

dialogue.content: ええ。
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: でかい、醜いとか言われます
dialogue.English: She says things like I'm huge and ugly.

dialogue.content: 自分はイケてるって、マウンと取ってくるんです
dialogue.English: She tries to assert her dominance, saying how great she is.

dialogue.content: それは本当に心がえぐられるような気持になると思います。
dialogue.English: That must feel absolutely gut-wrenching.

dialogue.content: 考えるとイラつくことばかりで、話しが尽きません
dialogue.English: When I think about it, it's just one irritating thing after another. I could go on forever.

dialogue.content: 本当に抱えて耐えてこられたのですね。
dialogue.English: You've truly been shouldering so much and enduring it all.

dialogue.content: その他に、苦しいと感じていることはいかがですか？
dialogue.English: Is there anything else that you're finding difficult?

dialogue.content: 会社帰りに子供を遅くに連れ帰って、ジジババのところで1時間ほど遊ぶんですが、それはたくさん」ジュースやおやつを与えてくれるんです
dialogue.English: On my way home from work, I pick my child up late, and they play at the grandparents' place for about an hour. They give the child lots of juice and snacks.

dialogue.content: おかげで私のご飯は食べません
dialogue.English: Thanks to that, my child won't eat the dinner I make.

dialogue.content: それから自分たちのキッチンに行って、ご飯の支度
dialogue.English: Then I go to our own kitchen and prepare dinner.

dialogue.content: 夫は帰りが遅いので、お風呂入れて、寝かしつけ
dialogue.English: My husband comes home late, so I bathe the child and put them to bed.

dialogue.content: それから食器洗いなどなど
dialogue.English: And then the dishes, and so on.

dialogue.content: でももう最近は、食器洗いをしなくなりました
dialogue.English: But lately, I've stopped doing the dishes.

dialogue.content: なぜでしょう？
dialogue.English: May I ask why?

dialogue.content: 疲れ切って、考えるのもめんどくさいし、ジジババからもらったせんべいも、お米だと思うことにしました
dialogue.English: I'm so exhausted, it's too much trouble to even think. I've decided to just consider the rice crackers from the grandparents as our meal.

dialogue.content: 家事出来ない、料理できない、シャワーはいるのもしんどいです
dialogue.English: I can't do housework, I can't cook, and even taking a shower feels like too much effort.

dialogue.content: 足を洗うのもめんどくさい、主婦としてサイテーです
dialogue.English: It's a pain to even wash my feet. I'm the worst housewife.

dialogue.content: 使うコップがなくなったら、洗います
dialogue.English: I only wash the cups when there are no clean ones left.

dialogue.content: 楽しいことが何もない
dialogue.English: There's nothing enjoyable in my life.

dialogue.content: この状態から抜け出したいです
dialogue.English: I want to get out of this state.

dialogue.content: 本当にぎりぎりの心身の状況でここまでこられたのですね。
dialogue.English: You've truly made it this far while being at your mental and physical limit.

dialogue.content: 普段の家事に加え、周囲に頼れない育児、同居されているお義母様からのご病気とは言え心無い言動、その疲れもありうまく回すことができない仕事で上司からの叱責…そういう中でよくここまで日々を重ねてこられましたね。本当に疲弊しきった中で我慢してこられたことと思います。
dialogue.English: On top of your usual housework, you're raising a child without support from those around you, dealing with heartless comments from your mother-in-law—even if it's due to her illness—and getting reprimanded by your boss at a job you can't manage well due to exhaustion... It's amazing you've managed to get through each day under these circumstances. You must have been enduring this while being completely worn out.

dialogue.content: 動きたくないけど、食べ過ぎて、10キロ太ってしまいました
dialogue.English: I don't want to move, but I've been overeating and have gained 10 kilograms.

dialogue.content: 夫からも、「このクソデブ！」と言われますし、
dialogue.English: My husband also calls me things like, "You fat pig!"

dialogue.content: 楽しいことも、生きていていいことも何もない
dialogue.English: There’s nothing fun, nothing good about being alive.

dialogue.content: 今だったら、息子、母の記憶ないから、今かな、と思います
dialogue.English: If it were now, my son wouldn't have any memories of his mother, so I think now might be the time.

dialogue.content: 今かな、と考えておられることとは何でしょうか？
dialogue.English: What is it that you are thinking now might be the time for?

dialogue.content: もう何もかも投げ出したい
dialogue.English: I just want to give up on everything.

dialogue.content: そこまで思い詰めていらっしゃるくらいお辛いのですね。
dialogue.English: It must be so painful for you to be feeling that desperate.

dialogue.content: 具体的なことは何かお考えですか？
dialogue.English: Do you have anything specific in mind?

dialogue.content: 別居婚したいくらいだけど、金銭的に無理だし、夢ですね
dialogue.English: I'd love to live separately from my husband while staying married, but it's financially impossible. It's just a dream.

dialogue.content: 住まいを離したいとお考えなのですね。今の状況から離れてしまいたいとお感じになるのは至極当然のことですよね。
dialogue.English: So you're thinking you want to live somewhere else. It's completely natural to feel like you want to get away from your current situation.

dialogue.content: しかし、現実的な金銭面でまだ可能な状況でないと判断されているのですね。
dialogue.English: But you've determined that it's not a realistic option financially at the moment.

dialogue.content: 夢ですね。とても現実的ではないと思います。自分はだらしなくて、主婦失格だし・・・
dialogue.English: It's a dream. I don't think it's realistic at all. I'm so sloppy, a total failure as a housewife...

dialogue.content: これだけ頑張ってこられているのに、そんなご自身のことをそのように責めてしまわれるのですね。
dialogue.English: Even though you've been trying so hard, you still blame yourself like that.

dialogue.content: それはさらに苦しくなるはずです。
dialogue.English: That must make it even more painful.

dialogue.content: ここまでお話されていて、これだけ我慢して抱えてそれでも歩みを止めずにこられたご自身を振り返って、どのようなことが頭に浮かびますか？
dialogue.English: Now that you've told me this much, when you look back at yourself, having endured and carried so much without giving up, what comes to mind?

dialogue.content: だらしがなくて逃げることくらいしか考えられない・・・ダメですよね…
dialogue.English: That I'm sloppy and can only think about running away... That's no good, is it...

dialogue.content: なるほど。そのような考えが浮かぶのですね。でも、頭によぎっているとはいえ、ここまでは逃げずに現実を生きてこられたのですよね。
dialogue.English: I see. So those are the thoughts that come to mind. But even if the idea has crossed your mind, you haven't run away. You've been facing reality up to this point, haven't you?

dialogue.content: そして、切れてしまうようにすべて突然放り出すこともせず、ここにお話にきてくださっている。
dialogue.English: And instead of suddenly snapping and throwing everything away, you've come here to talk.

dialogue.content: ぎりぎりのところであっても、しっかりと理性で判断できていますね。
dialogue.English: Even though you're at your breaking point, you're still able to make rational decisions.

dialogue.content: もし、大切なご友人がこのような状況でそれでも踏ん張ってなんとかしたいともがいているとしたら、あなたならどのように声を掛けますか？
dialogue.English: If a close friend of yours were in this situation, struggling but still trying to hang on, what would you say to her?

dialogue.content: 理性…
dialogue.English: Rational...

dialogue.content: 休んでいいよ。　かな・・
dialogue.English: I guess... 'It's okay to rest.'

dialogue.content: そのような言葉をかけてあげたいと思われるのですね。「ご自身に対しての言葉」として少しでも受け止めてみても良いと思うのですが、いかがですか？
dialogue.English: So that's what you would want to say. I think it might be good to try and accept those words for yourself, even just a little. What do you think?

dialogue.content: 休もうと思えばいくらでも眠れてしまいます。でも、夫にもいつもだらしのなさを指摘されて、汚い、とか言われ続けています
dialogue.English: If I try to rest, I can sleep forever. But my husband is always pointing out how slovenly I am, constantly calling me 'dirty' and things like that.

dialogue.content: なるほど。先ほどの「やすんでいいよ。」という言葉は、睡眠といったいわゆる体の休息を意味していましたか？
dialogue.English: I see. When you said, “It’s okay to rest,” did you mean physical rest, like sleep?

dialogue.content: だらしがなく片付けていないので、休んでばかりいるみたいに、自分も夫も思っている感じです。
dialogue.English: Because I'm messy and don't clean up, both my husband and I feel like I'm just resting all the time.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。そう思われるのも思うのも苦しいですね。あなたは気持ちの上で「やすんでもいいよ。」と声をかけたのかな？とも感じたのですがいかがでしょうか？
dialogue.English: I see. It must be painful to think that of yourself and to be seen that way by him. I felt that perhaps you meant 'it's okay to rest' in an emotional sense. What do you think?

dialogue.content: そうかもしれないです
dialogue.English: That might be it.

dialogue.content: まずご自身の心に、深呼吸をしながら「やすんでもいいよ。」と声をかけてみてはいかがでしょうか？
dialogue.English: How about you start by taking a deep breath and saying to your own heart, 'It's okay to rest'?

dialogue.content: 心に声をかけるのですね
dialogue.English: So, I should speak to my own heart.

dialogue.content: 自分の声は誰より自分が聞いているものですよね。
dialogue.English: You're the one who hears your own voice more than anyone else, after all.

dialogue.content: そうですね
dialogue.English: That's true.

dialogue.content: 環境すべてをご自身にとって良いものにひっくり返すように「今すぐ」に変えることはまだ難しい状況だと思いますが、まずは今後もここで引き続き色々思いを吐き出しながら、楽しいと思える日々にするための具体的な行動を一緒に考えられたらと思うのですが、いかがでしょうか？
dialogue.English: I think it's probably difficult to change your entire environment for the better 'right now,' but for starters, I was hoping we could continue to talk here, letting out all your feelings, and think together about concrete steps to make your days more enjoyable. How does that sound?

dialogue.content: はい。急には無理ですよねありがとうございます。
dialogue.English: Yes. It's impossible to do it all at once, isn't it? Thank you.

dialogue.content: またお話聞いてください
dialogue.English: Please listen to me again sometime.

dialogue.content: こちらこそよろしくお願いいたします。本日はお時間となりますのでここまでとなりますが、またいらしてください。何よりまずは御自身の心身をご自愛くださいね。
dialogue.English: Of course, I look forward to it. Our time is up for today, but please come again. Above all, please take good care of your mind and body.

dialogue.content: 聴いてくれてありがとうございました。
dialogue.English: Thank you for listening.

dialogue.content: またお待ちしております。本日は相談にお越しいただきありがとうございました。
dialogue.English: I look forward to seeing you again. Thank you for coming in for a consultation today.

dialogue.content: ※終了させていただきます。　クライアント役、ありがとうございました。　少しまとめたら終了いたします。
dialogue.English: *I will now end the session. Thank you for playing the role of the client. I will summarize briefly and then we will be finished.

dialogue.content: (大変良い勉強をさせていただきました。ありがとうございました)
dialogue.English: (This was an excellent learning experience. Thank you very much.)
